description: Automerge non-major dependency updates, and major updates of the actions GitHub publishes, after required checks pass

Automerge major updates of the actions GitHub publishes under actions/* and github/*; a PR-triggered workflow runs every action it uses, and their majors are mostly runtime moves such as a Node.js bump
Leave a move from Alpine 3 to a newer Alpine major for review; the Alpine rules in the inherited config classify it as a patch update
